UPDATE - Images 6, 7 and 14 got recleaned.

Shoujo Gekika Zōkan WENDY is an extremely rare, albeit mysterious doujinshi imprint from what appears to be the Wendy Torrance F.C. Magazine. While the amount of books produced by the circle is unclear, this particular circle published this text as a short supplemental book, more than likely for Comiket or for a mail order group. The main contents begin and focus on a variety of bishoujo themed works with characters who were popular in 'forbidden books' of the era - doujins that were based on vynil books (ビニ本, bini-bon). These publications were often sold sealed in polyethylene or OPP bags, preventing browsing prior to purchase and reinforcing their aura of exclusivity and taboo. The title itself is a play on Wendy Torrance, thus the depiction of Shelley Duvall in the titular role. The horrified expression and motifs and her appearance play into the 'shocking' elements of the circle and F.C.

Although their reputations suggest extremity, many surviving examples are relatively softcore in content. Some were privately commissioned or anonymously produced, while others took the form of collaborative goudoushi volumes bringing together both amateur contributors and more established artists of the period.

★Additionals:

Many of the artists in Shoujo Gekika Zōkan WENDY are Anonymous or simply not named whatsoever. There is only a short colophon, no publishing date or signed works, however, as this work features Godmars, the date it lands is anywhere between mid 1982 to even late 1983. With that said, the style, format and motifs appear to be closely associated with the circle known as Anime Comic Lolicon F.C. (アニメ・コミック・ロリコンFC), though this cannot be confirmed outright.

https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/r441157965

The Godmars doujinshi is clearly done by those who worked on Rose's Erotic Photo Album (ロゼ官能写真集), one of the rarest forbidden books ever made at the time, by the Six God Combination Godmars FC Akane:

https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/v1206819034
https://auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/p1110193687

★Context from one of the authors:

“Sorry, I’ve kept you waiting. I’m totally wiped out!!
Before I knew it, I’d been half-forced by Kaken-chan into doing lolicon after lolicon…
And somehow I ended up drawing ‘Pope Eleven’ on my back for the center spread (I don’t even know why…).
Hey everyone, don’t you have a weird old man like that lying around at home!?

But seriously—aren’t you all calling some girl over to your place right about now…?
If you don’t, Ebe-san might take your virginity instead?

BGM: Akira Ito, Yuka Sato
Ahh, I want a Nice Metal 2000-yen record… I want Yumi Arai’s LP too~!
I want Tatsuro’s new single tooooo—!!

By the way, why is it that I never run into any of you guys!?
Anyway, take care of me. Sorry this was so rough…”
